The two requested timeout cases were rerun after the binary-body fix:

```text
TestTimeout.test_connect_timeout       FAILED
TestTimeout.test_total_timeout_connect FAILED
```

Both fail because the sandbox immediately returns `OSError: [Errno 101] Network is unreachable` for `10.255.255.1`, which Requests correctly surfaces as `ConnectionError`, not `ConnectTimeout`. The test runner confirmed both failures also occur on the unmodified baseline, so they are recorded as pre-existing environment failures. Changing Requests to classify an unreachable network as a timeout would alter its error semantics and would not be an appropriate fix for this task.

The relevant binary-body regression tests pass:

```text
2 passed
```

The remaining failures are the two pre-existing timeout tests above.
